calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, remove its 60-day rolling beta exposure to the cross-sectional median market return from the five-day return, then negate and scale by lagged 20-day realized volatility. Higher values indicate stronger volatility-adjusted idiosyncratic reversal. All inputs are available only through the decision date's prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (0.040843; ICIR 0.118704), 2023-2024 (0.038152; 0.102772), and 2025-2026 (0.028965; 0.087059). The relatively low artifact coverage reflects the rolling beta warm-up and uneven cross-asset histories; usable dates require at least 8 instruments.
